Name: HCW Static Web App Deployer
Description: List the deployment token for static sites in rg-web-site-prod-cus. Microsoft.Web/staticSites/listSecrets/action is an action rather than a read, so no built-in read role reaches it, and the built-ins that do (Contributor, Website Contributor) also grant write over the resource. This is what lets deploy-azure-frontend.yml mint the token at deploy time under federated identity instead of holding it as a long-lived GitHub secret and a Terraform output (T-727). It grants nothing else: the holder cannot create, configure, or delete a static site. Consumed by infra/oidc.tf; created once by the owner because the Terraform identity deliberately lacks Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/write.
